run_gtest_shuffle_test: run the gtest_shuffle_test_ program with custom env vars and args to capture test output
get_tests_for_all_iterations: get a list of test lists from each iteration by running the gtest test program with flags
get_test_cases: extract unique test case names from a list of full test names in original order
calculate_test_lists: calculate and populate all test lists including shuffled, filtered, and sharded variants
test_shuffle_preserves_number_of_tests: test that shuffling preserves the total number of tests across all test categories
